title: Key West Theater

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Our main stage theater offers 278 seats, upstairs private balcony bar, dressing rooms and green room. Available for performances, weddings, conferences & more. Our Back Stage Listening Room offers 56 seated capacity and is great for intimate live performances, receptions, cocktail parties, readings, meetings, rehearsal & more. Our state of the art recording studio is located on the first floor of the theater can be utilized as a writing room or practice space. The Key West Theater will provide Box Office staff free of charge on the day of show beginning at 5pm when selling tickets through the KWT website.
